positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Rearchitected central components of event-sourced framework responsible for handling 15B Kafka messages daily, resulting in an 80% decrease in consumer lag and 95% CPU / memory usage reduction.
  - Seamlessly migrated 500+ real-time consumers between frameworks w/o delays, errors, or data loss.
- Redesigned retry mechanism backing 800+ Kafka consumers using DynamoDB as an intermediate store, improving retry delivery time and compute efficiency, reducing CPU / memory usage by 93%.
  - Introduced additional platform features: exponential backoff, DLQ, deeper monitoring + observability
- Developed a scalable pattern for building self-service tooling for devs to interact with the platform utilizing Lambdas.
- Discovered and resolved multi-year old bug in core libraries, bringing platform-sourced error rate closer to 0%.
- Added batch processing to custom data aggregation tooling, lowering write volume by 1000x during high load periods.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MySQL · Node.js · NestJS · TypeScript · fp-ts · Functional Programming · Apache Kafka · Helm (Software) · ArgoCD · Terraform · Datadog · Git

positions.title: Founding Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Acquired by Sound.xyz
- Built self-healing data ingestion system to process, enrich, and index millions of blockchain transactions and async events per day using AWS SQS and Lambda.
- Designed and implemented paginated home feed architecture that scaled to support dozens of unique content types, as well as natively supported caching for expensive modules. This surface comprises 25% of all time spent in the app.
- Refactored bottomsheets across the app, preventing background rendering and app slowdowns of 15+ seconds for older mobile phones.
- Managed Postgres database quality and health, optimizing queries, indexes, and connection pooling via PGBouncer.
- Extended app for release on Android, reaching feature parity with iOS app.
- Developed recurring async process for tracking arbitrary NFT portfolios and calculating total value, including users with 10k+ items.
- Refactored core data structure to support multiple currencies and new user onboards without mass deletions and re-ingestion. Successfully completed mass migration of 50M+ rows.
- Implemented Datadog monitoring to track success rate of async tasks and notification sends which helped identify system outages and bring success rates close to 100%.
- Led 3 other engineers in effort to audit client-side logging before public app store release.
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Node.js · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL · GraphQL · Git · Datadog

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Owned E2E implementation of personalized Shop and Product feed units which received 20M+ daily impressions and became one of the largest GMV drivers on Instagram.
  - Became tech lead for resulting workstream - led 3 other engineers, developing specs for various UI optimization experiments for them to implement.
  - Managed collaboration between 6 ML and product teams running experiments on our surface.
  - Designed and implemented various experiments to maximize ads budget and promotion utilization, resulting in further GMV growth.
  - Expanded feature to Stories surface, delegating client implementation to partner teams, adding 10M+ impressions daily to recommended Shops and Products.
- Extended Shopping Notification System by building data pipelines and backend to support notifying users of relevant new sales and discounts, increasing on-platform GMV.
- Presented tech talk on experimentation process and implementation to 20+ SWE and DS in IG Shopping pillar.
- Managed intern who built Shopping Notifications with topline impact to buyers. Intern later converted to full-time.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · ODS · Hive · Django · GraphQL · PHP · Mercurial

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed new Facebook Stories feature full-stack, from backend data model design to iOS client-side
- Extended new Objective-C framework for easier client-side development in the future
- Delegated tasks to full-time engineers to develop Android client-side for new feature

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Corrected service to better detect employee status changes and reduce unnecessary alerts
- Extended service to automatically transfer data pipelines as well as tables after employee status changes
- Created new asynchronous Python 3 service to notify employees of unsecured data pipelines

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Improved portfolio creation algorithms to handle and include international companies
- Expanded database by researching and scoring companies across several causes and issues

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Learned iOS app development using Swift via Codepath’s 3-week programming course
- Collaborated with team members and manager to build iOS app from the ground up within 5 weeks
- Utilized Parse and mongoDB to develop server backend for mobile app
- Showcased completed project to fellow interns and full time employees across multiple offices

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher for KamLAND-Zen
positions.description:
- Simulated reactions to generate neutrino-less double beta decay events
- Analyzed simulations to filter out background energies using a neural network

company.name: MIT Department of Nuclear Science and Engineering

positions.title: Quality Assurance and Research Intern
positions.description:
- Improved facial recognition algorithm through annotation of 6,000+ images
- Developed biometric anti-spoof methods using internal sensors of mobile phones
- Presented to corporate executives to showcase benefits of EyePrintID

positions.title: Telecommunications Intern
positions.description:
- Worked closely with professional engineers on project to replace antennas on cell towers across the US
- Responsible for editing and reviewing CAD drawings of cell phone tower sites in various metro areas

positions.description:
- Edited CAD drawings, printed and bound them for client presentations
- Designed safety labels to be utilized at telecommunications campus for machinery
